$comment: F3-D12 DRAFT vendor master (15 widely used B2B software/cloud suppliers). Used for alias matching and for restricting supplier-news web searches to official domains. Not loaded by any harness.

provenance.authorship: Model-authored list of well-known public vendors. Brand names, official domains and parent relationships are public facts checked as described per field below. Nothing here comes from tenant data.
provenance.domainCheck: On 2026-10-15 each officialDomains[0] was requested over HTTPS from the sandbox (curl, follow redirects). domainCheck values: ok = HTTP 200 on the stated host or its canonical redirect; bot_blocked = HTTP 403 from the vendor's bot protection (host exists, content not verified); unreachable = no response from the sandbox (not verified).
provenance.legalEntityNames: legalEntityHints are from model knowledge of public corporate names, NOT checked against any company register. verified is false everywhere. Do not use them for matching without a registry check (see PENDING_REVIEW.md).
provenance.parentRelations: parent is a long-standing public fact (acquisition announced by the parent). Re-check before relying on it for consolidation advice.
provenance.licence: Facts (names, domains) carry no licence restriction; trade names belong to their owners and are used here for identification only.
sources: Salesforce ownership of Slack: model knowledge of the 2021 acquisition, not re-fetched this session; verify

matchingNotes.rule: Aliases are case-insensitive whole-word matches; ambiguous aliases must not match alone without a second signal (domain, product context).
matchingNotes.excluded: Vendors whose domain could not be reached or whose parent relationship is contested were not added; a tenant's own suppliers come from tenant data, never from this file.
